why: MWU! is a named astronomy curriculum comprising reusable multi-wavelength observing modules, rather than a general instructional element or merely a one-off lesson design.
name: MWU! (Astrophotography of the Multi-Wavelength Universe!)
product_description: A DoD-funded curriculum developed by Daniel E. Reichart and collaborating educators that provides eight Skynet-based optical and radio astronomy observing experiences for undergraduate astronomy courses.
